name: Abandoned Checkout Recovery (Started, Unpaid)
purpose: Recover contacts who started checkout and remain unpaid. The sequence fires only after a start with no purchase, re-checks the purchase tag before every send, and stops the whole lane permanently on the purchase event.

trigger.what_starts_it: Contact starts checkout (Step 1 contact details captured) and stays unpaid past the abandon window of 30 minutes.
trigger.ghl_trigger_type: Form Submitted on Step 1 order form -> Wait 30 min -> IF/ELSE tag 'purchased-[offer-id]' NOT present -> enter sequence
trigger.reentry_guard: Enter only if tag 'cart-abandon-started' is NOT present AND tag 'purchased-[offer-id]' is NOT present

on_purchase: Stop all abandonment nodes for this contact and offer

channels: SMS / Text (secondary, only when email not opened)

sequence.delay_note: Measured from checkout start. Runs only when still unpaid at the gate.
sequence.purpose: First recovery touch. Soft, helpful, direct link back to checkout.
sequence.subject: Did something come up? Your [offer name] is waiting for you
body_framework: Hey [name] - looks like you started checking out [offer name] and something came up before you finished.
No worries - your order is still here.
One-line value reminder: what they were about to get plus the key benefit
Direct link back to checkout: [Complete your order here: {{checkout_url}}]
Friction reducer: {{guarantee_statement}} or how fast delivery is

sequence.beat: Email open branch -> SMS nudge (if not opened)

gate.then: email_opened? -> skip this step; not opened -> send SMS and Messenger

sequence.purpose: Switch channel only when the email went unopened. Short, direct, no pitch.
sequence.sms: Hey [name] - [AC name] here. You started grabbing [offer] a bit ago. Here is the link to finish: {{checkout_url}}. No pressure at all.
sequence.messenger: Hey [name] - you were grabbing [offer] earlier! Here is the link to finish up if you want: {{checkout_url}}. Happy to help if you have any questions.

sequence.purpose: Address the most common hesitation with a short story and restate the guarantee.
sequence.subject: The #1 thing people worry about with [offer name] (and what actually happens)
body_framework: Short customer story that names the objection and resolves it

sequence.purpose: Light urgency only when a real reason exists. No fabricated countdowns.
sequence.sms: Hey [name] - quick heads-up: {{urgency_reason}}. Link: {{checkout_url}}. No worries if the timing is not right.
sequence.messenger: Hey [name] - quick heads-up: {{urgency_reason}}. Here is the link: {{checkout_url}}. No worries if the timing is not right.
sequence.urgency_rule: Send only with a genuine reason. If none exists, use {{urgency_reason}} as a plain check-in, never a fake deadline.

sequence.subject: Last note about [offer name]
body_framework: This is my last message about [offer] - I do not want to fill your inbox.
Real deadline if one exists; otherwise the link stays open: {{checkout_url}}
Graceful close and what they will keep receiving

sequence.beat: Purchase event - stop all and route
sequence.delay_note: Fires immediately on purchase at any point in the sequence
sequence.purpose: Hard stop. No abandonment message may send after a purchase.
actions: Stop every node in this lane for the contact and offer

ghl_build.draft_only_state: Every workflow is created as a draft. Triggers are written `status: draft` and `active` stays gated by CAF_DRAFT_ONLY. Nothing sends, nothing goes live. Live switch-on is a separate client approval.
workflow_nodes: If/Else: purchased-[offer-id] present? Yes -> exit to buyer onboarding; No -> continue
Email CA-01 You Left Something Behind
If/Else: purchased? Yes -> exit; No -> If email opened in 2h? Yes -> skip; No -> SMS CA-S01 and (if messenger-subscribed) Messenger CA-M01
If/Else: purchased? Yes -> exit; No -> Email CA-02 Story/Objection Handle
If/Else: purchased? Yes -> exit; No -> SMS CA-S02 and (if subscribed) Messenger CA-M02
If/Else: purchased? Yes -> exit; No -> Email CA-03 Last Call
ghl_build.purchase_interrupt: Add purchased-[offer-id]; remove cart-abandon-started; stop all lane nodes; start buyer onboarding.
ghl_build.notes: Set order and parentKey on every node before first save. Emails CA-01..CA-03 in GHL Email Builder; SMS CA-S01..CA-S02; Messenger CA-M01..CA-M02.

copy_persona.tone: Helpful, personal, low-pressure. The AC is a trusted guide who noticed the prospect stopped, not a pushy salesperson.
copy_persona.voice: First person from the Attractive Character. Personal sign-off.
copy_persona.email_mechanics: 150-300 words max. Short paragraphs. One CTA per email - the click back to checkout.

flexibility.core_principle: This lane is a guide and a resource, never a rule. The user's explicit desire wins.
flexibility.timing: 30 min / 2h / 24h / 48h / 72h are defaults. Compress for high-ticket; extend for subscriptions.
flexibility.non_negotiable: The purchase check before every send and the hard stop on purchase.

build_graph_resolution: Authoring choices that clear the prose-only 'missing' reason: the 'email opened in 2h? Yes -> skip' branch targets the 22-hour wait node (n12, a join). The SMS (sms-subscribed) and Messenger (messenger-subscribed) guards are sequential if_else nodes, and each false arm continues to the next node. Every 'purchased?' check plus the final email joins at x1 (remove cart-abandon-started), then x2 workflow_goal: the purchase goal event stops the lane at any point, and buyer onboarding starts from the post-sale family.
